acceptance_condition: A matched-compute experiment crossing communication (none/SC vs SoM-style debate) x pool (homogeneous vs heterogeneous models) on >=3 task strata, reporting accuracy with CIs and a preregistered decision rule: if Heter-SC >= Heter-MAD, diversity-only is supported; if Heter-MAD > Heter-SC by a preregistered margin, communication adds identifiable value.
rationale: Zhang's 'universal antidote' compares Heter-MAD only to same-model MAD averages and CoT-Average; without a heterogeneous-SC control, the heterogeneity result cannot distinguish a diversity-only mechanism (decorrelated errors suffice) from a deliberation mechanism (communication adds value given diversity). This is the pivotal discrimination for the root note's causal model and its predictions.
text: Under matched LLM-call and token budgets, does heterogeneous self-consistency (each sample drawn from a distinct model, majority vote, no inter-agent communication) match or exceed Heter-MAD, and does the answer interact with task type?
